content.text:
Updated the package to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md` and corrected the README entries for `conversions_in_window` and `daily_conversion_counts`.

The package review also uncovered and fixed issues with parser error line numbers, group ranking and tie-breaking, per-group rate ordering, and streaks not resetting on nonpositive counts.

Added regression tests confirming that `None` counts as an unconverted session and that the last record for a duplicate ID wins even when it has an earlier day. All 20 tests pass with `python -m pytest`.
